verdict.rationale: Mintlify's docs say it automatically generates both llms.txt and llms-full.txt so AI tools can index a site. A live probe confirms an llms.txt is served (HTTP 200) on Mintlify's own published site, and llms.txt files also appear under /docs and /blog. The blog notes generation was rebuilt as a hierarchy of files so agents can reach every page. Missing for 10: hands-on confirmation that the llms-full.txt variant is actually served.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my published docs site automatically serves llms.txt (and a full-content variant) so agents can index it

citations.quote: Automatically generate llms.txt and llms-full.txt files so AI tools like ChatGPT and Claude can index and understand your documentation.
We rebuilt generation as a hierarchy of files so agents can reach every page without loading the entire index.
